data.rationale: The proposal matches the true goal and the step sequence (open hotel search, type destination, pick dates, adjust guests, search, filter and sort), but it puts rooms/guests before Search where the true run adjusts them after, and it leaves filters and sort vague ("style, amenities, stars", "price or distance"). It also splits the dates into two parameters and doesn't name rooms and guests as separate inputs, so an automation would need guesswork.
